name: Guahalan Spirit Beast
description: A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal.

abilities.name: Minion (5)
abilities.description: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Ethereal Form
abilities.description: The Spirit Beast has resistance to physical damage.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

abilities.name: Beast Bomb
abilities.description: When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within Melee range.
